title: Posterior Contraction Rates for Sparse Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks in Anisotropic Besov Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2605.11652v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study posterior contraction rates for sparse Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) over anisotropic Besov spaces, providing a statistical foundation for KANs from a Bayesian point of view. We show that sparse Bayesian KANs equipped with spike-and-slab-type sparsity priors attain a near-minimax posterior contraction rate. In particular, the contraction rate depends on the intrinsic anisotropic smoothness of the underlying function. Moreover, by placing a hyperprior on a single model-size parameter, the resulting posterior adapts to unknown anisotropic smoothness and still achieves the corresponding near-minimax rate. translated_title: 各向异性Besov空间中稀疏Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的后验收缩速率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了各向异性Besov空间上稀疏贝叶斯Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）的后验收缩速率，从贝叶斯的视角为KANs提供了统计学基础。我们证明，配备尖峰-厚板型稀疏先验的稀疏贝叶斯KANs能够达到接近极小极大的后验收缩速率。特别地，该收缩速率取决于目标函数本身的内在各向异性光滑度。此外，通过对单一模型规模参数设置超先验，所得后验能够自适应未知的各向异性光滑度，并仍然达到相应的接近极小极大的速率。与标准多层感知机的相关结果相比，我们结果的一个显著特点是KAN的深度可以保持固定：得益于可学习样条边函数的表达能力，所需的近似复杂度通过网络宽度以及稀疏性的范围和规模来控制。
tldr: 本文证明了配备尖峰-厚板稀疏先验的稀疏贝叶斯Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在各向异性Besov空间上可达到接近极小极大的后验收缩速率，能通过超先验自适应未知的光滑度，且网络深度可保持固定。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that sparse Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks with spike-and-slab sparsity priors achieve near-minimax posterior contraction rates over anisotropic Besov spaces, adapt to unknown smoothness via a hyperprior, and can keep the network depth fixed.
